newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate rises to 14.98 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate rises to 14.98 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills rose to 14.98 percent at the latest weekly tender after falling to 14.95 percent last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 700 million rand of bills on offer totalled 2,891 million rand. The average price was 96.265 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 15.01 percent from 14.91 percent. Applications for the 200 million rand of bills on offer totalled 920 million rand. The average price was 92.515 rand percent.
